kojima.name: Hideo Kojima
kojima.credit: Invented the strand game genre. Connection IS gameplay. Carrying things to isolated people. That IS what the membrane does.

hillenburg.name: Stephen Hillenburg
hillenburg.credit: NP = FUN. You can't optimize fun. You can't compress friendship into O(1). Every child who sang that song was doing mathematics.

google_gemma.name: Google DeepMind
google_gemma.credit: Architecture > parameter count. Efficient small models.

mistral_ai.name: Mistral AI (Paris)
mistral_ai.credit: European open AI. Apache 2.0. The 7B size class proof.

microsoft_phi.name: Microsoft Research
microsoft_phi.credit: Data quality > scale thesis. MIT license.

stability_ai.name: Stability AI
stability_ai.credit: Small model dreaming. Efficient creative generation.

deepseek.name: DeepSeek

ollama.name: Jeffrey Morgan & Ollama team
ollama.credit: Made local LLM inference trivially easy. IT IS the inference backend.

codellama_team.name: Meta AI (Code Llama team)
codellama_team.credit: Code-specialized Llama. The forge that builds Gaia's code tissue.

wizardlm_team.name: WizardLM team (Microsoft)

mathstral_team.name: Mistral AI
mathstral_team.credit: Mathematical reasoning. LaTeX. Proofs. The tissue that computes.

rust_community.name: The Rust community
